projects.name: Bay Estate
projects.description: Bay Estate is Nakheel's gated coastal community at Dubai Islands. Its Verda, Cala and Agora neighbourhoods combine family homes with landscaped public spaces and waterfront facilities. The residential offering includes three- and four-bedroom townhouses, four-bedroom villas and a separate selection of villa plots.
